inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "The camp of the leader and his four surviving officers after the Sovereign wiped out their alien army, their home between runs, an open stretch of land with room for each officer to have a work station and tools. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. No people anywhere, the officers are added later. This camp, the camp sits in the cupped open palm of a colossal fallen stone statue hand half buried in the sand, its huge cracked stone fingers curling up behind the camp like walls, moss and vines in the cracks, the landmark of the camp.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn camp with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth and scale", "lighting": "Warm late afternoon sun from the upper left, long violet shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the camp ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#3d7fc6", "#8cbce8", "#f6d6a0", "#e8b45a", "#c0823c", "#a8a090", "#7a7468", "#4a463e", "#5a8a4a", "#c43a2e", "#f2a24a", "#e8e0cc", "#d0c4a8", "#b4a48a"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One game camp screen seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top part is sky over a distant horizon. Behind the camp the scenery stands in overlapping rows at different depths, hazier and paler the further away. The lower part is one wide open flat ground for the camp, calm and empty in the middle, with four work stations spread to its corners and a campfire in the middle.", "elements": [{"type": "obj",
